training_dataset: HSEmotion EfficientNet-B0 AFEW pretrained facial-expression model
preprocessing: Detected face crop with 15% margin, center-trimmed by 8% per edge; RGB; resize to 224x224; ImageNet channel normalization
output_mapping: Drops contempt and maps the remaining AFEW outputs to FER2013's seven labels
video_aggregation: Mean class probabilities across sampled frames

ravdess_pilot_diagnostic.split: actor 05 used for blend comparison; actor 06 held out
ravdess_pilot_diagnostic.warning: Only two RAVDESS actors are present. Actor 06 was consulted during model comparison, so these values are diagnostic and not an unbiased generalization estimate.
